extraction_notes: Datasheet title is HL3400 N-CHANNEL MOSFET, Rev. 1.0, from Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology Co., Ltd.; all five pages were examined.

Transfer, output, capacitance, gate-charge, on-resistance, and normalized on-resistance curves were read directly from the labeled traces in p. 3. The points are direct curve reads at graph-grid positions; no points were generated from an electrical model or extrapolated beyond the plotted axes.
Figure 2 prints the horizontal axis as VDS-GATE VOLTAGE; it was recorded as VGS because the figure is the transfer characteristic and the plotted test condition is VDS = 5 V.
IDSS maximum is 1.0 uA at VDS = 30 V and VGS = 0 V, TJ = 25 degC (p. 2); the strict schema has no dedicated IDSS field.

Gate-body leakage maximum is +/-100 nA at VGS = +/-12 V and VDS = 0 V; gate resistance maximum is 3.6 ohm at VDS = 0 V, VGS = 0 V, f = 1 MHz; forward transconductance minimum is 8.0 S at VDS = 5.0 V and ID = 5.0 A (p. 2). These fields have no dedicated schema properties.
Total gate charge typ is 17 nC, gate-source charge typ is 2.0 nC, and gate-drain charge typ is 2.0 nC at VGS = 10 V, VDS = 15 V, ID = 5.6 A (p. 2); the gate-charge curve is included above.

The datasheet publishes RthetaJA maximum 104 degC/W for a 1 in2 FR-4 board with 2 oz copper in still air at TA = 25 degC, but no RthetaJC; thermal impedance and safe-operating-area plots are not represented in the strict schema.
No body-diode reverse-recovery time trr is published. Maximum ratings include VDS = 30 V, VGS = +/-12 V, ID = 5.6 A, and TJ = -55 to +150 degC.
